activity.notes: Bogislaw had inherited part of the Pomeranian territories in 1474. After the death of his uncle Wartislaw X in 1478 he became the sole ruler of all Pomerania. Because the requested polity is Pomerania as a whole, ATLAS begins this Activity with the reunified duchy in 1478 rather than implying that he already ruled all Pomerania from 1474.

sources.title: Bogislaw X. — Deutsche Biographie
sources.citation_text: Neue Deutsche Biographie states that after Wartislaw X's death in 1478 Bogislaw became sole ruler of all Pomerania and that he died on 5 October 1523.
